tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (4 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Four-drone coordination exercise: Drone 12, Drone 8, Drone 6, and Drone 2 take off together to 18 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (483, 514, 18), (583, 481, 18), (539, 529, 18), and (438, 670, 18) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all four drones move north for 65m, and next move east for 82m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 65m, then east 82m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 65m, east 82m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Four-drone formation drill: launch Drone 12, Drone 8, Drone 6, and Drone 2 to altitude 18m, hold stations at (483, 514, 18), (583, 481, 18), (539, 529, 18), and (438, 670, 18) respectively, then shift north by 65 meters and east by 82 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 12, Drone 8, Drone 6, Drone 2: take off reaching 18 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (483, 514, 18), (583, 481, 18), (539, 529, 18), and (438, 670, 18) respectively, then proceed north for 65m and subsequently east for 82m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Four-drone coordinated maneuver: Drone 12, Drone 8, Drone 6, and Drone 2 lift off to 18m elevation, hold formation positions at (483, 514, 18), (583, 481, 18), (539, 529, 18), and (438, 670, 18) respectively, then travel north 65 meters and east 82 meters in sequence. The specified directional distances must be achieved by each drone, adapting position to circumvent any obstacles.
